implied_262k_prefill: Measured anchors, then arithmetic to 262,144 tokens. (a) 8 GB laptop, Inkling-2-Mini stock: 101 t/s at 10k = 43 min if flat, ~1.4 h with a 2x-per-doubling penalty past 32k (llamaperf/X, https://x.com/analogalok/status/2124135141555720653). (b) Tuned same card: 545 t/s at 4k = 8 min, but unattainable at 262k because 3.1 GB of KV cannot co-reside with 12.8 GB of weights in 8 GB (https://llamaperf.com/report/5bf6d33d-95cb-4d70-9716-1610b0deb416). (c) 6 GB RTX 4050, 35B-A3B with RAM offload: ~292 t/s implied by a reported 2-min TTFT at 34-36k -> 15 min flat, ~2 h with fall-off (https://llamaperf.com/gpu/rtx-4050-6gb). (d) Worst laptop-class measured curve, 96 GB unified iGPU 27B Q4: 168 t/s at 35k and 'halves per position-doubling' -> ~21 t/s at 262k = ~3.5 h, which the author independently calls 'hours-scale' (https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/discussions/27154). (e) 24 GB RTX 3090, Inkling Q4: 400 t/s at 32k -> 45-90 min (https://llamaperf.com/report/c78bd998-45a8-4f2e-bed4-1b1772058d6a). (f) Measured directly at length: 715 t/s at 250k on A100-40GB = 6.1 min (https://llamaperf.com/report/81901eb9-d3e4-450c-9269-5938707e659c) and 1,193 t/s at 262k on RX 7900 XTX = 3.7 min (https://llamaperf.com/report/9849c2ad-44ef-4ba2-869a-0ff9b2d6053e); 209,715 tokens at 1,772 t/s on 4x V100 = 2 min (https://github.com/1115714829/llama.cpp-v100/blob/v100-2.0.1.1/docs/v100/benchmarks.en.md); 512,444 tokens after a 90.8-min cold prefill on an M2 Max (https://llamaperf.com/report/e2fa78b2-e87f-43ab-8da7-81b17e3a4b01). CONCLUSION: a 6 GB laptop GPU lands between 15 min and ~2 h for 262k, with ~45 min the most defensible single figure for a 12B-class model that mostly lives in host RAM. No baseline implies days. This engine's measured 0.11 s/token = 9.09 t/s = 8.0 h is therefore 4-30x off the real baselines, not 200x; the 200x figure is the pp512 gap where the model fits and the comparison is pure arithmetic throughput (1,828.8 t/s vs 9.09 t/s). Most of the recoverable factor is two kernels plus residency: MMQ-class quantised tensor-core GEMM is worth 5.7-6.3x over dequant-then-cuBLAS on the same card (https://zenn.dev/toki_mwc/articles/rtx5090-blackwell-cuda-toolkit-trap-llama-cpp), tensor cores themselves 5x versus a coreless GPU (https://www.pugetsystems.com/labs/articles/llm-inference-consumer-gpu-performance/), and fused flash attention 3.1x at 32k, with a 20-37x SILENT penalty if a quantised KV type fails the CUDA FA kernel gate and the op falls back to CPU (https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/27109).
